given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
given_when_then.then: the system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review

given_when_then.given: A settlement event triggers for a completed delivery
given_when_then.then: The sum of all distributed amounts equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record

given_when_then.given: A Financial Transaction Record is generated for a completed delivery
given_when_then.when: The system validates the transaction against the Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.then: The settlement calculations strictly adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement

given_when_then.given: A Financial Transaction Record is generated for a completed delivery
given_when_then.when: The system assesses the transaction for risk indicators
given_when_then.then: Transactions involving high-risk indicators are paused for manual verification before settlement

success_criteria: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record containing a split of revenue between the Platform Operator, Store Partner, and Payment Provider.
Financial distribution only occurs after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
The sum of all distributed amounts equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
Transactions involving high-risk indicators are paused for manual verification before settlement.
Settlement calculations strictly adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
A Financial Transaction Record is generated for every completed delivery regardless of the outcome.
